connect_visdom_server: connect to a visdom server with optional server address and port parameters
check_visdom_connection: check if the client is currently connected to a visdom server
plot_learning_curves: plot a dictionary of learning curves as line graphs in visdom
plot_loss_functions: plot pytorch loss functions as curves over a score range in visdom
visualize_model_graph: visualize a classy model computation graph in TensorBoard using a summary writer
